appDesc.message: Shows line-count proportions on GitHub's file list, so bloated files are obvious at a glance.

unitLinesOrMore.description: $1 is a line count with its unit

metricLinesTitle.message: Show the bars and shares as line counts

metricBytesTitle.message: Show the bars and shares as file sizes

pickAllTitle.message: GitHub Lines: include or exclude every row

pickRow.message: Include this row in the view and the fetch

pickRowLeft.message: Include this row in the view and the fetch ($1 not yet counted)
pickRowLeft.description: $1 is a file count with its unit

fetchSizesTitle.message: Fetches the file listing in one request and shows each file's size

fetchLinesCount.description: $1 is how many files pressing it will fetch

fetchLinesTitle.message:
Fetches the file listing, then the line count of every file in the ticked rows
(one API request per file)

fetchLinesCountTitle.message:
Fetches the line counts of $1 files from GitHub
(one API request each; files already counted are not included)
fetchLinesCountTitle.description: $1 is how many files pressing it will fetch

fetchNothingTicked.message: Tick the rows you want counted

fetchDoneLinesTitle.message: The ticked rows have been counted

summaryBiggest.description: $1 is a name, $2 a measurement, $3 a percentage

restItems.description: $1 is how many further entries are folded into one segment

errRateLimit.description: $1 is the parenthesised time left, or empty

errRateLimitAnon.message: API rate limit (60/hour unauthenticated) — add a token in the options

errSecondary.message: Paused by GitHub's secondary rate limit$1
errSecondary.description: $1 is the parenthesised time left, or empty

errThrottled.message: Fetched too fast — waiting, then resuming

errBadToken.message: $1 is not valid — check the options

errPrivate.message: Private repository — add a token in the options

errTimeout.message: The background is not responding — reload the page

errReloaded.message: The extension was reloaded — reload the page

tipUnknown.message: GitHub Lines: no information for this entry (a submodule, perhaps)

tipBinary.message:
$1
Binary, so its lines are not counted ($2)
tipBinary.description: $1 is a path, $2 a byte size

tipGenerated.description: $1 is a path, $2 a byte size

tipMaxFile.description: $1 is a line count with its unit

tipOverDanger.description: $1 is a line count with its unit

tipNearWarn.description: $1 is a line count with its unit

tmRefining.message: Counting lines $1/$2 — the rest is estimated from byte counts (~)

tmArea.description: $1 is the name of a metric — lines or size

rampTick.description: $1 is a line count with its unit

optLede.message: Shows a proportion bar and a treemap for the line counts inside a directory, on GitHub's file list.

optTokensHint1.message: It works on public repositories without one, but the GitHub API rate limit is then 60 requests an hour. A token raises that to 5,000 an hour and reaches private repositories.

optTokensHint2.message: With more than one account, register several tokens and assign them per owner (a user or an organization). One account's token cannot read another account's private repositories.

optTokensHint3.message: — the only permission it needs is Repository permissions → Contents: Read-only. Tokens are kept in this machine's chrome.storage.local and are sent nowhere but api.github.com.

optTokenDefaultTitle.message: The token to use when no owner matches

optTokenOwners.message: Owners this token is for (comma separated)

optTokenVerify.message: Verify and fill in the owners

optThresholdsHint.message: A file past these line counts is coloured as a warning.

optShowBars.message: Show proportion bars on the file list

optModeAuto.message: Automatic — fetch as soon as the page opens

optModeManual.message: Manual — fetch nothing on open. Pick lines or size on the strip above the list and press the button; the row checkboxes narrow what it fetches

optModeOff.message: Off — estimates only, one API request per view

optModeHint.message: In every mode, files counted before show their real value from the cache, without an API request.

optCacheHint.message: Counts are cached under the file's blob SHA. A git blob SHA is a hash of the content, so a file whose content has not changed is never fetched again, whatever the branch or commit.

optExcludeGenerated.message: Exclude files matching the patterns below

optPatternsHint.message: Binaries (images, fonts, archives and the like) are recognised by extension and always excluded.

optOwnersFound.description: $1 is a list of owner names

optOwnersMore.description: $1 is a list of names, $2 how many are not shown

optOwnersNone.message: could not work out which owners it reaches — fill them in yourself

optVerifyOk.message: valid as $1 — $2 ($3/$4 requests left this hour)$5
optVerifyOk.description: $1 login, $2 what it reaches, $3/$4 requests left, $5 a note about its kind

optSaved.description: $1 is how many tokens were saved

optLang.description: The BCP 47 tag for this catalogue, for the options page's lang attribute
